description: This source file defines functions for managing dynamic arrays of strings, called 'strvec'. It includes functions for initialization, adding elements (including formatted strings and multiple strings), removing, replacing, splicing, splitting by whitespace, clearing, and detaching the internal array. The implementation uses macros and functions for memory allocation and string duplication, indicating a utility module for string vector manipulation.

methods.name: void strvec_init(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Initializes the strvec structure to an empty state.

methods.name: void strvec_push_nodup(struct strvec * array,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a string to the vector without checking for duplicates.

methods.name: const char * strvec_push(struct strvec * array,const char * value)
methods.description: Duplicates and adds a string to the vector, returning the added element.

methods.name: const char * strvec_pushf(struct strvec * array,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a string, adds it to the vector, and returns the added element.

methods.name: void strvec_pushl(struct strvec * array,...)
methods.description: Adds multiple strings to the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_pushv(struct strvec * array,const char ** items)
methods.description: Adds multiple strings from an array.

methods.name: void strvec_splice(struct strvec * array,size_t idx,size_t len,const char ** replacement,size_t replacement_len)
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the vector with new strings.

methods.name: const char * strvec_replace(struct strvec * array,size_t idx,const char * replacement)
methods.description: Replaces an element in the vector at a specified index.

methods.name: void strvec_remove(struct strvec * array,size_t idx)
methods.description: Removes an element from the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_pop(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_split(struct strvec * array,const char * to_split)
methods.description: Splits a string by whitespace and appends parts to the vector.

methods.name: void strvec_clear(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Clears the vector, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: const char ** strvec_detach(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Detaches and returns the internal array of strings, resetting the vector.
